title: linociera leprocarpa var. courtallensis
intro: Linociera leprocarpa var. courtallensis, commonly known as the 'Courallenis' or 'Kerala Linociera', is a plant species native to the Western Ghats region in India. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its multiple health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Linociera leprocarpa var. courtallensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
